steps.en: Read the twelve factors (the short version is one list in the README)
steps.zh: 读完 12 条 factor（README 里一页清单）

steps.en: Names each failure you hit: a hidden prompt, an opaque context, a loop you can't pause
steps.zh: 给你踩的坑命名：看不见的 prompt、黑箱上下文、停不下来的循环

steps.en: Audit your agent factor by factor and pick the ones it breaks
steps.zh: 逐条对照你的 agent，挑出它违反的几条

steps.en: Shows a code pattern per factor, e.g. your own loop branching on the model's chosen step
steps.zh: 每条附一段代码范式，比如自己写循环、按模型选的下一步分支

steps.en: Port the pattern into your existing code: your prompt, your loop, your saved thread
steps.zh: 把范式搬进你现有的代码：自己的 prompt、循环和存档的对话线程

value.en: Agent behavior becomes code you own: you can read the exact prompt, pause before a risky tool call, and resume later
value.zh: agent 的行为变成你自己的代码：看得到真实 prompt，高风险工具调用前能停下，之后再接着跑

sources: https://github.com/humanlayer/12-factor-agents README — The Short Version: The 12 Factors; Agents as loops
